coordinate_system.origin: southwest outer corner of interior envelope

modeling_contract.room_rects: Rooms tile the gross footprint without overlap. floor_rects are zoning rectangles, not clear wall-to-wall measurements.
modeling_contract.walls: a/b are wall centerlines. at is metres from a along a→b. Remove openings from the actual mesh between bottom/top; do not cover with a panel.
modeling_contract.sliding_doors: clear_intervals are metres along wall.a->wall.b. parked_panel_zones are world X intervals for the SOUTH facade only. Keep 3m actual clear opening.
modeling_contract.hinged_doors: open_leaf explicitly gives hinge and open tip in XY; keep their swept footprint free.
modeling_contract.beds: Bed size is unrotated local [width,length,height]; head points local +Y at rotation 0. rotation_z_degrees rotates model and footprint.
modeling_contract.windows: All four bedroom heads and full-height wardrobes are on internal or opaque wall segments; low desks may sit below 0.85m sills.
modeling_contract.integration: Standalone Blender samples only; no bulk R1-R4 residential integration in this task.
modeling_contract.furniture: Furniture footprints are planning reservations, not assertions of final mesh bounds. When collision_rects exist, use those solid parts for planning navigation; decorative rugs are walkable.
modeling_contract.primary_source_bed: Reuse supplied user suite furniture at scale1; source group needs correct clone anchor and may be reflected for02 without scaling its dimensions.
modeling_contract.assembly: Origins are final-world positions. yaw is radians. mirror_x reflects LOCAL X after yaw: world=T(origin) Rz(yaw) Scale(-1,1,1). All dimensions remain metre scale.
modeling_contract.bedrooms: Exactly three bedrooms; living and dining are the two halls. Separate service laundry occupies the sheltered end of the balcony. Floor zoning includes walls.

title: 02 三房两厅独立住宅样板 · 镜像阅读型

area.basis: 15.6×11.5m含墙平面范围；房间分区面积不是净使用或销售面积，15.6×2.8m阳台单列

design_differences: 01主卧在西南，02主卧在东南，两个北卧对应镜像。
01厨房东侧移门正对餐厅；02厨房南侧移门经短厅廊连接餐厅。
01公卫从玄关侧面进入；02公卫由餐厅北侧进入，玄关侧墙封闭。
01餐桌东西向、客厅双沙发会客；02餐桌南北向、单主沙发配窗边阅读工作区。

furniture.planning_status: Source bed remains 1:1; reservations approximate the source solids and require final mesh verification. Group bounds include a walkable rug.

planning_validation.method: 50mm grid using wall solids, parked balcony panels, open door leaves and reserved furniture footprints; 300mm pedestrian radius. Requires final evaluated mesh audit.

viewer.description: 三房两厅 · 双卫 · 15.6米大阳台

refinements.laundry_position: Shifted from balcony end to solid wall between primary south window and living balcony aperture; west linear planter relocated into vacated service position. Mirrored for02.
refinements.verification_basis: Transform of initial actual-mesh-audit mesh_inventory, 40 laundry meshes checked against 137 balcony meshes; zero projected 3D AABB overlap after planter relocation. Final rebuilt model requires repeat audit.
